title: The Shed That Took Four Years
subtitle: 改变成长 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 改变成长（做人与做事·改变与成长）
meta: 主题语境：改变成长（做人与做事·改变与成长）　|　核心词汇：idea　|　正文 381 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 idea 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: At twenty-two I had an ① idea and no skills, which is the ordinary condition of being twenty-two. The idea was a workshop at the bottom of the garden; the ② idea behind it, which I could not have stated then, was that I wanted a place where nobody could tell me what to do. My father, who had built two houses, said the ③ idea was sound and the timing was not, and he was right about both.

He gave me one rule: draw it before you buy anything. I drew it badly for four months, and in the fifth month the drawing changed, and in the sixth I understood why. An ④ idea held only in the head is not an idea; it is a mood. Once it is on paper it has corners and a cost, and you can argue with it, which is the only way it improves.

The building took four years, mostly weekends. What I had no ⑤ idea about was the order of things: the base has to be level before anything else, and I spent eleven weeks on a base and eleven months regretting the eleven weeks I had saved. My father watched this happen and said nothing, which I resented at the time and have since come to admire as a teaching ⑥ idea.

Halfway through the second year I ⑦ had no idea whether to finish. Everybody I asked said yes, which was no help at all; what helped was a builder who came to look at the roof, stood in the rain for four minutes, and said it would cost more to stop than to go on. That is not encouragement. It is information, and information is what I needed.

The shed was finished in 2011. My father died in 2013, and I have used it for eleven years, and in all that time I have never once had the ⑧ idea he predicted — that I would get bored of it. What I got instead was the ⑨ idea he never mentioned: that a thing you have made will tell you what you are capable of, on the days when you would rather not know. I now tell that to anybody with the ⑩ idea of building something and no skills, which is why nobody invites me to parties.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 想法；主意；念头
B. n. 打算；意图；目的（the idea behind）
C. n. 概念；观念；认识（对事物的理解）
D. n. 打算；念头（the idea of doing 做某事的打算）
E. n. 原则；理念；做法（作为教学／行事方法）
F. 固定搭配：have no idea 完全不知道；毫无头绪
G. 固定搭配：the idea that ... ……这样的想法／念头（后接 that 从句说明内容）
H. n. 想法；猜想；预感（that 从句说明内容）

items.q: I had an idea and no skills
An idea held only in the head is not an idea
What I had no idea about was the order of things
have since come to admire as a teaching idea
I had no idea whether to finish
I have never once had the idea he predicted
What I got instead was the idea he never mentioned
anybody with the idea of building something

answers.why: 指一个具体的“想法、主意”，即建一间工坊。
the idea behind 意为“背后的意图、打算”，说真正动机是要一个没人管的地方。
父亲评价这个“想法”本身站得住，只是时机不对。
idea 指“概念、观念”，说只存在脑子里的不叫想法，只是一种情绪。
have no idea about 意为“对……毫无概念／完全不懂”，说我对施工顺序一无所知。
指一种“做法、理念”，说父亲沉默旁观是一种教学上的做法。
have no idea whether 意为“拿不准、不知道”，说第二年我拿不准备是否该完工。
the idea that ... 后接 that 从句，指“……这样的念头”，说他预言我会厌倦的那种念头从未出现。
同样后接 that 从句，指我得到的那个“认识、念头”。
the idea of doing 意为“做某事的打算”，说我把这话讲给任何打算动手却没本事的人。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 二十二岁时我有一个想法，却没有任何手艺。（idea）
这个想法背后的动机，我当时说不出来。（the idea behind）
只存在脑子里的念头不算想法。（idea）
我对施工顺序完全没概念。（have no idea about）
第二年我拿不准要不要完工。（have no idea whether）
他预言我会厌倦，这个念头从未出现在我脑子里。（idea）
answers: At twenty-two I had an idea and no skills.
I could not have stated the idea behind it at the time.
An idea held only in the head is not an idea; it is a mood.
I had no idea about the order of things.
In the second year I had no idea whether to finish.
I have never once had the idea that I would get bored of it.
